turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My sister's wedding is in June and I've offered to sort the photographer. I'm overwhelmed.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Just listen while I lay them all out, and I'll ask for your view at the end.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a guy from her work who does it on weekends, cheap, but his website only has a few weddings on it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A proper studio in town quoted us a lot, but they bring two shooters and a printed album.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then a student from the art college who's really talented and hungry, though she's never done a wedding alone.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or we could put disposable cameras on every table and let the guests do it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all of them. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Weddings only happen once, so I'd lean away from the coworker with only a few weddings to show. The student is the best value if you meet her first and see a full gallery. And the table cameras would make a sweet bonus either way.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I ask about something else? What's the difference between a major and a minor chord?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It comes down to the middle note. In a minor chord it's one half step lower, which gives it that sadder sound.
